headline: Backup Report for Travis County Homes
summary: Homes in Travis County face an elevated risk. Records from 8 years since 2018 show a long outage of 12 hours or more about once every 10 years. In February 2021, 43% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 96 hours. In February 2023, 29% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 132 hours. One Core lasts about 14 hours in August. One Core lasts about 30 hours in February. Two Cores last about 21 hours in August. 2 Cores from sizing.cores cover 74% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
